data.one_liner: A collection of animated loading spinner widgets for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides dozens of pre-built spinner widgets that can be used as loading indicators. Each spinner is a stateless widget that can be customized with color, size, and optional animation controller.
use_when: You need a quick loading indicator without writing custom animation code
You want a variety of spinner styles to choose from
You want const constructors for compile‑time optimization
avoid_when: You need a custom animation that is not one of the provided spinners
You require complex stateful logic inside the spinner
weaknesses: Limited to the provided spinner set
No support for custom animation logic beyond the provided options
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:flutter_spinkit/flutter_spinkit.dart';

const spinner = SpinKitRotatingCircle(color: Colors.white, size: 50.0);
